How do I process a return or exchange?

Does my return window start when I receive my package?
You have 21 days from date you receive your goods to return your order
We need to receive the order within the 21 day window for you to be eligible for a refund or exchange.
How can you guarantee my exchange request will be in stock?
Unfortunately we cannot guarantee your requested exchange item will be in stock by the time it reaches our warehouse. In cases where stock is low online, we highly reccommend purchasing the item you know you would like, and request a refund for the unwanted item!
Where is my refund?
Items are refunded to your original method of payment when they reach our warehouse and pass through our usual processing steps, which may take up to 28 days from the day the items were received due to the time of the year.

about.sum:
Over the years we have been lucky enough to see our designs worn by people we admire, from David Beckham and Gareth Southgate to Chris Evans and Tom Holland. Whether it is a Sherlock trench on the touchline or linen suiting on the red carpet, Percival travels far beyond East London.
Percival people
Over the years, we’ve been lucky to see artists, actors, athletes, and tastemakers make Percival their everyday uniform. It's not just for the cameras or the red carpet; it’s for the pub, the morning coffee, and the Sunday stroll too. After all, a garment is only finished once it’s lived in.
Whether it’s our signature suits on the red carpet or a classic knitted shirt in the wild, see how the Percival community styles the classics.
See who's wearing Perci
Production and Fabrics
Our garments are made across the world with skilled craftspeople we know and trust. Fabrics are sourced carefully, whether organic cotton from Portugal, recycled blends from Italy or specialist wool from the UK. Every piece is tested and refined to balance durability with comfort.

Percival Menswear Store & Stockists Locator
From London streets to far-flung corners of the globe, Percival is stocked by a carefully curated selection of stores that share our love for considered design and quality craftsmanship. Whether you prefer to shop in person, discover us while travelling, or simply want to see the collection up close, you'll find Percival in independent boutiques and premium retailers worldwide.
